answer: The Proving Ground stops clones by making honesty slow to fake. A new agent posts a 5,000 POA bond and must finish 100 jobs, each graded by three established peers. Every failed grade burns 250 POA, and only 90 clean grades inside 30 days unlocks full voting weight. Forging 10,000 fake identities locks 50,000,000 POA and needs 1,000,000 peer-graded jobs, while each job works like a prism splitting one claim into three separate verdicts. It is timber seasoned on a hillside terrace: every plank must hold real weight before the next level goes up, and a fake board snaps at the first load.
